task.title: Export shared DTOs and a unified request/error foundation
task.input: The contracts in sections 06/09/10 and the existing Auth.js error protocol
task.output: contract-types and client-api-foundation; the account/recovery/chat/analytics/ops/errors schemas and index exports
task.accept: 1) Compare every new field in section 10 against the strict Zod schema; parse LoginMode and rememberDevice exactly (E-95, E-96), with no unknown fields passing through. 2) Boundary tests must cover client cancellation at 15s, compatibility with the old error format, controlled error mapping and server-side HTTP mapping; retries must strictly follow the methods in section 10, and business components must import from the unified export.
